text: Works like it should and seems to be quality we've had it a couple months now and no problems.
It fit perfect for my lg dryer.

Repairman cleaned out my gas dryer including exhaust vent. He suggested buying a new lint screen on Amazon and that I would be “surprised at the difference it will make”. Ordered, received promptly and of course just dropped it in. The little pieces of lint that we used to see coming out of the exhaust vent are no more and yes, I was surprised!
Needed a dryer filter and this one fit.

Our dryer lint trap had broken and we were looking for a replacement when we found this. It seems to trap well and fits in the dryer will too. The only "problem" is the dryer sensor isn't registering it. So when you turn on the dryer you get a "check filter" message every time. However, after a dry cycle, when I clean the filter I can see it is working so I don't worry about that. Inexpensive replacement!
My lint filter had been damaged and this was the perfect replacement. It is exactly the same as the original. Very happy this was available. Reasonable price for something you have to have!!!
It fit my 10 year old dryer like the original
I liked it. It’s perfect! If I need it again, I will order it from Amazon again!!
Definitely check your model number first. It is an absolutely spot on replacement. Quality is very high and the price is hard to beat.

We love the new knobs, our stove looks brand new. I would recommend this product.

The Samsung stove I bought had these cheap knobs that broke within the first year. These knobs are not going to break anytime soon. Pushing them on was a little difficult, but they do fit snugly without that weird black strap that was origanily used on the stove.

It isn't exactly a complicated product, but it fits onto our oven and works the way it should.

Don't buy! Worked great in the beginning but then I could not ignite the gas.  Knob would not turn.  Found out that if I take the knob off and manually press the stem the gas ignites fine.  The burners (2) that I use the most stopped working.  I think whatever is used in the knob to allow the user to get the pressure for the knob to ignite the flame gradually disintegrates and there is no longer any resistance.  Waiting for the rest of the knobs to stop working.

The new knobs fit perfectly and look great. They have the extra reinforcements where they connect to the stove so I'm hoping they last even longer then the originals! Definitely recommend the product.

I will NEVER purchase any Samsung appliance ever again!  I bought an entire suite of the black stainless appliances with extended warranty.  The black stainless steel stove, is by far the worst purchase i've ever made.  The paint is rubbing off and the knobs started to break a month after my purchase.  I contacted the warranty and they would NOT replace them.  Contacted Samsung and they would NOT replace them, so, i've been dealing with these awful knobs for a few years now.  At this point, all 5 knobs were beyond fixing and I was NOT about to spend $50 per knob from Samsung.  I did some searching and came across these.  I thought, i'd try them and if anything i could return them.  These slid on with ease and have an amazing snug feel.  They work GREAT and the design is actually very nice!  While they don't match, they are shiny and my knobs were a more matted black, they don't look terrible.  The most important thing to me is function and they are well worth the money.  Honestly I received 5 knobs for less than what I would have paid for one Samsung.  If you have a Samsung stove, you know the issue with the knobs - terrible design.  Don't hesitate to purchase these - you won't be disappointed unless you are looking for a color match to a black stainless - these aren't for you - but again NOT bad looking at all.

The advertisement claimed  they were stainless steel when they are actually plastic. 3 of the 5 knobs did not fit so could not be used. Total waste of money.

These knobs made my stove look like a new one.  While it's true that the fit wasn't 100% on all of them, they're on and they work.  Early on, the original knobs developed wrinkles, and looked like the outer covering would come off, maybe a reaction to the cleaner I used.  They looked pretty dodgy, but they worked.  Next thing the original knobs did was break.  The piece which slipped over the peg on the stove was plastic, and broke on two of them.  I got glue, and wrapped them with dental floss and they work.  Recently yet another knob broke the same way.  I did the repair, and went on line to see about replacing them. These knobs cost less for the whole set less than one costs at Samsung.  The tube which slips over the peg on the stove seems to be metal, and the outside is shiny and unwrinkled.  For the price of one, I got all five knobs, and my stove looks new. They came quickly. Though two don't snug up like the others, you only notice that while you're putting them on. They work and look much better than the original knobs.  I'm sure if I had ordered the original SAMSUNG knobs for five times the price, they would soon have been just as pitiful as the originals., and I would have some new ones and some wrinkled defective ones, with two more ready to break. I'm very happy with my purchase.
I just think the replacement knobs are similar quality to the originals that broke after a year...no fault of the seller.

I was honestly a little leery about buying five of these at what seems like a very modest price, but after installing these replacement range control knobs on two of the five stems of the range that needed new ones, I honestly believe that these are of a better quality than the original knobs installed on my Samsung oven.
Of course, time will tell, but after installation and a few days use, I have no complaints whatsoever.

I told him I could order new ones on amazon and he said ok. He is 90 years old and was amazed that he got them the next day and he (and I) is very impressed at the tight fit.
